snippet.title: Between Guilt, Dreams and Reality – FRUSTRAIN Waiting Hall Launch
snippet.description:
We’ve just opened the WAITING HALL — a pre-launch world from our indie game FRUSTRAIN.

It’s part story, part experiment. You can walk around, listen, find details — everything means something.

🕹️ Playable on: Mobile / VR / Browser
On @VIVERSEOfficial platfrom - FOR FREE 👾

Curious — do you enjoy slow-burn psychological horror, discovering thriller stories and puzzles or do you prefer fast-paced jumpscare chaos? 👀
